decisions.summary: the declaration is l7r/diagram/buildings/types.json read by types.py, one object per type with tier/title/program/hand_drawn/generated_exceptions/required (label regex + band_ft, optional)/checks/notes
decisions.why: FR-001 asks for exactly these fields declared once as data the engine reads; the JSON-asset-outside-the-engine-key shape follows feature 207 and settles a mechanism the spec left open. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: poolmaps.classify, pool_index.MODE_A_DIRS, _size_table's usage line and the sweep derive from the declaration; COMPOUND_GENS retired; a census test greps l7r/ and scripts/ for a tier name outside its allowed homes
decisions.why: FR-001 names those four consumers verbatim and SC-001 asks for the census; the undeclared-tier case staying 'unknown, loudly' is the spec's first edge case. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: .gitignore keeps one negation per hand-drawn tier plus a re-ignore per declared generated exception, held to the declaration by a test
decisions.why: FR-001's last sentence asks for the ignore rule per tier with a test holding it to the declaration; the second edge case asks for the generated-exception handling. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: the precinct is the rect(s) marked id="precinct"; the five magistracy SVGs gain the attribute on their court-earth rect (PNGs byte-identical); the parser raises when none is marked
decisions.why: FR-002 asks the shared layer to read the precinct from the sheet's own declaration of it and to fail naming a sheet that declares none; US1 scenario 3 is the fence-and-hedge case this serves. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: a Check registry in tools/pack_audit/registry.py - Check(name, run, types, fixture, fix), types=None meaning shared - from which report.py composes; vacant rectangles, region density and aligned gaps stay report figures and are not registered; coverage and perimeter hugging ARE registered (D6)
decisions.why: FR-003 and FR-005 ask for checks that declare their types and each carry a red fixture; the dataclass shape and the module split are mechanism the spec left open. Round 1's N1 - the declassification of the coverage band and perimeter hugging to report figures - is WITHDRAWN here; the three that remain unregistered (vacant rectangles, region density, aligned gaps) are never called checks by the spec, so excluding them narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: the magistracy's checks are coverage_band (the shipped 37-42% jin'ya band made pass/fail), perimeter_hugging (floor DERIVED from the five pool sheets, measured and recorded as m:hugging-floor before the check lands, an exception put to the GM if no honest floor exists), notice_board_adrift and two_court_zoning, each with a named red fixture; eleven checks are shared; the fire-water three declare types=frozenset({magistracies, country-shrines})
decisions.why: This is round 1's N1 finding resolved as the verdict asked. FR-003 ('those that are the magistracy's (coverage band, perimeter hugging, notice board by the gate, two-court zoning) move under the magistracy') and the Edge Case of the same name are now carried in full: both are registered, so FR-005's red fixture, SC-003's registry count and FR-004's gate sweep reach them, and US1's Independent Test (b) holds for every named per-type check. The 37-42% band was verified by re-reading the shipped report (report.py line 47 prints "jin'ya band 37-42%"), so making it pass/fail needs no new derivation; perimeter_hugging has no shipped threshold (report.py line 50 prints a bare percentage at a 25 ft depth), and deriving the floor from the five sheets with the escalation route named, rather than demoting the check, is the course the round-1 verdict prescribed. The conditional 'exception put to the GM' is an escalation, not a decision taken here, so it carries no ruling.

decisions.summary: program completeness and size bands are generic code over the declaration; the size table's nearest-label pairing moves into pack_audit/labels.py and _size_table.py becomes a thin caller; a notes 'form: one roof' makes one building count as hall and dwelling
decisions.why: FR-003 says both are per-type in mechanism but generic in code reading the declaration and the same size table size-audit is handed; edge case 3 asks for the combined-building counting when the notes declare the form. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: three new shared checks (structures_overlap by sorted-edge sweep, scale_bar_present, viewbox_cropped with a 25 px margin bound), one new magistracy check (two_court_zoning) and four shrine checks (sanctuary_on_axis, arch_on_approach, well_clear_of_arch, fence_not_wall), each with a red fixture
decisions.why: FR-002 names structures overlapping, the scale bar and the cropped viewBox; US1 names the sanctuary-behind-the-hall-on-the-axis composition rule; FR-008 puts the arch, the well and the fence-never-a-wall in the program. WALL_OVERLAP_MIN_PX was verified to exist at 0.5 px (checks.py line 33); the 25 px bound and the tolerances are numeric choices the spec left open. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: any check that fires on a shipped magistracy sheet during registration is fixed in this work and recorded in that sheet's notes, never ledgered as pre-existing
decisions.why: FR-004 requires the live pool to pass the sweep, and constitution XIV requires fixing defects where found. Unchanged at round 2, and it now also covers whatever the two newly registered magistracy checks turn up.

decisions.summary: the sweep is tests/gate/test_mode_a_sheets.py parametrized over poolmaps.bundles(kinds=('compound',)), listed in the gate roster, cost recorded as m:sweep-cost
decisions.why: FR-004 asks for a gate test of the pool listed in the roster whose failure names sheet, check and fix; SC-002 asks for the measured cost under the ratchet. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: the required-items table in programs.md is rendered from the declaration for BOTH types between <!-- types.json:<tier> --> markers written by make building-programs; the magistracy's existing bullets are converted, their per-item reasoning moving into each item's why; type-level prose (knobs, anchors, staffing, the cart route, the guest-door rule, the divider gate) stays hand-written around the block
decisions.why: This is round 1's N1/D11 finding resolved as the verdict asked: the narrowing that left the magistracy's required list hand-written and unrendered is explicitly withdrawn, so FR-001's 'declared once, as data the engine reads and the docs render from' and Key Entities' Program ('rendered from and consistent with the declaration') now hold for every declared type, and FR-006's reviewers read a block that cannot drift from the checks. What stays hand-written is type-level prose the declaration does not hold - FR-001 enumerates required items, labels, bands, checks and the hand-drawn flag, and FR-009 asks for the knobs in the entry - so rendering it is not something the request asks for; the treatment is symmetric across both types, which is what the round-1 finding turned on. Noted for the author, not a narrowing: the Project structure block's comment on buildings/programs.md still reads '+ Country shrine (rendered block between markers)' and under-describes the magistracy's conversion that D11 and Phase 3 both carry.

decisions.summary: the exemplar is pool/country-shrines/hoshigaoka-shrine/, with knobs set to one roof, bell absent, dedication from Hoshigaoka's clan patron Fortune, grove west / burial ground east, wealth average
decisions.why: The spec's Assumptions leave the village choice to the plan, from the legacy village exhibits - Hoshigaoka is one - and carry the round-1 aside that the exemplar takes its dedication from the clan patron Fortune by the record's town rule. The knob settings match FR-009's defaults. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: record mechanics: two new h2 sections after the village-shrine section, footnotes fn-143 on, SOURCES.html entries, eight glossary terms, make citations / make glossary, class entries updated, and the agent order source-reader, quote-verbatim + quote-check, record-prepass + record-format, source-applicability in three grouped dispatches, entry-drift
decisions.why: FR-012 to FR-014 and SC-004 ask for exactly this content and these agents; the section placement, footnote numbering and dispatch grouping are mechanism the spec left open. Unchanged at round 2.

decisions.summary: Phase 3 carries the FR-006 edits to .claude/agents/building-review.md and .claude/agents/size-audit.md - the prompts name the program by type and read the type's rendered block - and the Project structure block lists both agent files
decisions.why: This is round 1's N2 finding resolved as the verdict asked: FR-006's requirement that the two reviewers' prompts 'name the program by type rather than by the magistracy' was in no phase and no structure entry, and is now in the phase the verdict named (Phase 3, with the programs.md and buildings.md work) and in the files-touched block, so the Phase 5 exemplar is reviewed against prompts that know the type. Adding no agent, as FR-006 requires.

decisions.summary: Phase 0 is labeled 'research: rendering' (tooling, nothing physical behind it) rather than the round-1 draft's third class 'research: procedure'
decisions.why: Not a narrowing of the request or the spec; it settles the round-1 note that tests/test_task_research_boxes.py admits only 'research: rendering' and 'research: physical', and the declaration/tooling work behind Phase 0 makes no physical claim.

decisions.summary: the new structures_overlap check uses a sorted-edge sweep over a few dozen rects with no spatial index, and the plan says why rather than adding one
decisions.why: The spec does not constrain the algorithm; CLAUDE.md only asks that a plan adding an overlap check say how it is indexed, which this does.

decisions.summary: the constitution XIII baseline is make quick ALL=1 plus make hooks-test in a detached worktree, recorded as m:baseline-quick, rather than a full gate baseline
decisions.why: The spec sets no baseline form; constitution XIII asks for a measured baseline in a detached worktree, which this is, and measurements.json now records it (3640 passed, 5 skipped, at 7cc2e95b).

decisions.summary: every required item in the declaration carries 'class' (one of the four labels) and 'why' (a research anchor) beyond the fields FR-001 enumerates
decisions.why: An addition, not a narrowing, and it serves the research doctrine's requirement that every rendering decision carry its class at the point of change; at round 2 the 'why' field also carries the magistracy's converted per-item reasoning (D11).

decisions.summary: a new make target, make building-programs, writes the rendered required-items block between markers and CHECK=1 fails the gate when it is stale
decisions.why: The mechanism by which FR-001's 'the docs render from' is enforced; the spec left the mechanism open, and at round 2 it applies to both types.
